02/11.11.2024
 Heard the parties.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Khunti (M) P.S. Case No. 15 of 2024, for the offences registered under Sections 376(2)
(n), 323, 504 and 506 of the I.P.C., pending in the court of Sri Manoranjan Kumar No.1, learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Khunti.
It appears that petitioner and prosecutrix had entered into consensual physical relationship.
Subsequently, there was some dispute between them due to which this case has been instituted.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that victim is aged about 41 years and she is a married lady.
It was further submitted that parties were in physical relationship since 2014 and the present case has been instituted after ten years.
Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail.
In view of the submissions made above, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Sri Manoranjan Kumar No.1, learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Khunti or his successor in connection with Khunti (M) P.S. Case No. 15 of 2024.
